usage: insight_eval.py [-h] [--fixture FIXTURE] [--t5-fixture T5_FIXTURE]
                       [--data-dir DATA_DIR] [--keep] [--json]

Fork: the Today insight eval: rule order, learned weights and the T5 fallback
order.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --fixture FIXTURE     the day fixture (JSON)
  --t5-fixture T5_FIXTURE
                        the T5 host test's day (JSON, a copy of the module's
                        fixture)
  --data-dir DATA_DIR   where to write the files (default: a temp dir)
  --keep                keep the temp dir
  --json                print the checks and score as JSON
